questions.question_text: 2026-09-30 20:00 US/Eastern 이전에 PHLX Semiconductor Index(^SOX) 일봉 종가가 2026-06-03까지의 역사적 최고 종가(동 CSV 기준)를 엄격히 초과한 거래일이 한 번이라도 있는가?
questions.resolution_criteria: research/market_data/sox_daily_external_yf.csv (^SOX Yahoo Finance). reference_high = max(Close) for rows with Date <= 2026-06-03. Window: 2026-06-04 <= Date <= 2026-09-30 (NYSE 거래일). TRUE if any Close > reference_high. All window closes <= reference_high => FALSE. CSV unavailable or reference_high undefined => VOID.

questions.question_text: 2026-07-01 ~ 2026-09-30 US/Eastern 거래일 중 ^SOX 일간 수익률이 −5.00% 이하(하락 5%p 이상)인 날이 한 번이라도 있는가?
questions.resolution_criteria: research/market_data/sox_daily_external_yf.csv. Daily return (Close_t/Close_{t-1}−1) <= −0.05. on any row with Date in 2026-07-01..2026-09-30. TRUE if >=1 day. FALSE if none. VOID if >=5 consecutive missing rows in window.

questions.resolution_criteria: research/market_data/sox_daily_external_yf.csv. reference_high = max(Close) for Date <= 2026-06-03. Threshold = 0.90 * reference_high. Window 2026-06-04..2026-09-30: TRUE if any Close <= threshold. FALSE if all Close > threshold. VOID if reference_high undefined.
